description: Structured Data Report: pages grouped by schema.org @type, which pages have none, and which pages carry an unparseable JSON-LD block — for a project's latest completed crawl (or a named earlier one). Derives entirely from structured data already extracted at crawl time — no new crawl-time work. PRESENCE AND PARSE VALIDITY, NOT A RICH-RESULTS ELIGIBILITY CHECK. Only `typeGroups[].invalidCount` on the BreadcrumbList group is a real, verified per-type validity verdict; every other type reports only whether pages declare it and whether ANY block on the page failed to parse (page-level — never attributable to one type when a page declares several). ALWAYS narrow on `state` first: `no_audit` (no completed crawl yet), `analysed` (`typeGroups: []` means every page was measured and none declared any structured data — a real finding, not a withheld section). `notDerivable` lists what this report can never compute, and why. Free — charges no credits, makes no external call.

auditId.description: Audit ID, from crawl_site or get_crawl_results. Omitted means the latest completed audit for this project.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_audit_structured_data
